message.content:
This is the fix. The commit `a01a139a` "Pull in htscodecs bug fixes" fixes "1-byte buffer overruns in arith_uncompress_to() and rans_uncompress_to_4x16()". This is the fix for our issue (42491972). The htscodecs submodule goes from `dca826b` (our current version) to `e8d8597e`.

Let me look at the diff of the htscodecs fix. Let me look at the commit `cf8eca1` which is the specific fix for the 1-byte buffer read-overrun in arith_uncompress_to.

From cf8eca188b84fea2089d67d90b0a92dc70b1e8c8 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
    From: James Bonfield 
    Date: Thu, 21 Jan 2021 16:47:46 +0000
    Subject: [PATCH] Fix OSS fuzz 1-byte buffer read-overrun.
    
    Credit to OSS-Fuzz
    Fixes oss-fuzz 29792
    ---
     htscodecs/arith_dynamic.c | 2 ++
     1 file changed, 2 insertions(+)
    
    diff --git a/htscodecs/arith_dynamic.c b/htscodecs/arith_dynamic.c
    index e45233d..e18953a 100644
    --- a/htscodecs/arith_dynamic.c
    +++ b/htscodecs/arith_dynamic.c
    @@ -928,6 +928,8 @@ unsigned char *arith_uncompress_to(unsigned char *in,  unsigned int in_size,
     
     	// Decode lengths
     	c_meta_len += var_get_u32(in+c_meta_len, in_end, &ulen);
    +	if (c_meta_len >= in_size)
    +	    return NULL;
     	unsigned int N = in[c_meta_len++];
     	unsigned int clenN[256], ulenN[256], idxN[256];
     	if (!out) {
